public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Stardust Solutions is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Yanai Yedvab that has raised $75M to date. The sector comp universe includes one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers spanning battery materials, energy storage, and industrial decarbonization, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Valuation analysis relies on a stage-progression methodology, as peer-median triangulation is not applicable. The Climate & Energy sector contains eight comparable companies, but insufficient granularity exists within same-stage and adjacent-stage filters to support a narrow peer median—a minimum of three datapoints is required. Accordingly, stage-progression applies a 2.0x multiplier to the $75M raised proxy, implying a post-money valuation of $150M for the Series A round.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $128M to $172M, centered on $150M, grounded in a single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.0x step-up multiplier for this specific subsector and stage, the absence of transaction-level data from comparable Series A fundings, and limited visibility into Stardust's unit economics relative to the peer set. A peer-median approach would strengthen conviction if additional same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables can be identified or if internal performance data becomes available for benchmarking.
